label: Weekly Shopify report
text: Every Monday I export Shopify orders to Google Sheets and build a sales summary. I use Claude Desktop, and ChatGPT at work.

items.text: Every Monday, export Shopify orders to Google Sheets
items.quote: Every Monday I export Shopify orders to Google Sheets

items.text: Build a sales summary from those orders
You also use ChatGPT at work

needs.reason: Claude already does this on paid plans: a scheduled task can run this report every Monday, even when your computer is asleep. Nothing to add.

shopify-connector.why: You export Shopify orders every Monday. With Shopify's own connector, Claude can read those orders straight from your store instead.
shopify-connector.how_it_helps: Claude can pull last week's orders and totals itself, so the export and copy step goes away.
shopify-connector.do_you_need_it: It's the piece that gets your orders into Claude.
shopify-connector.skip_if: Skip it if Shopify's built-in reports already give you the summary you need.
shopify-connector.summary: Shopify's official connector for Claude. It reads orders, customers and sales; it can also edit products, so ask it for reports only.

google-drive-connector.why: Your weekly orders end up in Google Sheets. Google's connector lets Claude open that sheet and save each new week into your Drive.
google-drive-connector.how_it_helps: Claude can read last week's numbers to compare and save the new orders into your Drive, with no downloading or uploading by hand.
google-drive-connector.do_you_need_it: You need it if the report stays in Google Sheets. To edit a sheet live, also turn on Claude's Google Sheets connector (beta).
google-drive-connector.skip_if: Skip it if you'd rather keep the summary inside Claude and stop using the sheet.
google-drive-connector.summary: Google's official Drive connector for Claude: search, read and save files in your Drive, including Sheets.

claude-for-google-sheets.why: You build the sales summary by hand each week. Claude can do that inside the sheet itself, with formulas that keep working.
claude-for-google-sheets.how_it_helps: Ask in the sidebar for a summary tab with total sales, order count, average order and top products, and it builds it in place.
claude-for-google-sheets.do_you_need_it: It fits how you work today, building the summary by hand in Sheets. Claude Desktop with the two connectors can also write it for you.
claude-for-google-sheets.skip_if: Skip it if your Google admin blocks Marketplace add-ons, or you'd rather Claude Desktop do the whole report.
claude-for-google-sheets.summary: Anthropic's add-on that puts Claude in a sidebar inside Google Sheets, Docs and Slides (beta, paid plans).
